title: Nationalmuseum: Masterpieces
subtitle: Twenty works about gatherings, solitary tasks and the surroundings that make a portrait.
introduction:
A dance, a breakfast table and an evening gathering offer three different ways of bringing people together. In these works, companionship does not require everyone to look at everyone else. It may be established by turning bodies, a pool of lamplight or a table prepared for a meal. The solitary figures are equally specific: a hand supports a head, a woman writes, a painter works outdoors in snow.

This selection moves between Swedish painting and works by Rembrandt, Zurbarán, Renoir and Cézanne. Instead of treating them as a procession of national schools, follow the forms of attention they describe: how someone looks, waits, works or shares a space.
visitNote: The selection belongs to Nationalmuseum’s collection, but some works may be on loan, at another collection site or in storage. Watercolours rotate for conservation. Check individual collection records and current visitor information before expecting all twenty in the main building.

books.title: The Practice and Science of Drawing
books.author: Harold Speed
books.note: The chapters on tone and the arrangement of a picture offer a practical companion to Pauli, Zorn and Liljefors. Compare their different uses of a bright surface or dark silhouette before applying a general stylistic label.

works.title: Midsummer Dance
works.credit: Anders Zorn. Midsummer Dance. Anders Zorn; Nationalmuseum, Sweden (museum-contributed reproduction). https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Midsummer_Dance_(Anders_Zorn)_-_Nationalmuseum_-_18607.tif. Public Domain Mark (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/mark/1.0/). Full-frame proportional resize and JPEG compression.
works.description: The maypole is not the painting’s centre. Zorn gives more space to the turning couples, whose shirts catch the lingering night light. His account of the work describes painting after sunset in June and July. The particular light therefore belongs to the picture’s making as well as to its subject: this is a night scene that does not become dark.

works.title: The Kitchen Maid
works.credit: Rembrandt van Rijn. The Kitchen Maid. Image credit: Rembrandt; Source credit: Nationalmuseum. Public domain (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/mark/1.0/). Proportional resize and JPEG compression; full source frame retained.
works.description: The hand pressed against the woman’s head makes resting an action with weight. Her red clothing and pale linen emerge from darkness, but the ledge also holds her close to the spectator. Whatever the traditional title suggests about her occupation, the picture’s immediate subject is this particular arrangement of a person pausing.

works.title: Blossoming Acacia Branches
works.credit: Blossoming Acacia Branches. WikiArt; Vincent van Gogh. Proportional resizing and JPEG compression; source frame preserved.
works.description: There is no distant view through which to approach the flowers. Yellow blossom and green leaves fill the field, their directions established by clustered strokes. Some branches are easy to follow; others disappear into the surrounding marks. Growth is presented as an entanglement rather than a botanical diagram with each part isolated.

works.title: Simeon in the Temple
works.credit: Simeon in the Temple. WikiArt; Rembrandt van Rijn. Proportional resizing and JPEG compression; source frame preserved.
works.description: The child’s small body rests in an old man’s hands, and the contrast of scale supplies the scene’s essential relation. Faces and wrapping emerge without equally clear surroundings. This concentration keeps the biblical encounter close to an act of handling: the significance of the infant is conveyed through how carefully he is received.

works.title: The Conspiracy of the Batavians
works.credit: The Conspiracy of the Batavians. WikiArt; Rembrandt van Rijn. Proportional resizing and JPEG compression; source frame preserved.
works.description: The swords bring separate men into a common action above the illuminated table. Some faces remain difficult to distinguish, while the convergence is clear. Rembrandt gives the oath a collective form without making every participant equally legible. The light joins them around a decision rather than presenting a row of independent portraits.

works.title: Carl Gustaf Tessin
works.credit: Portrait of Carl Gustaf Tessin. WikiArt; François Boucher. Proportional resizing and JPEG compression; source frame preserved.
works.description: Books, a globe and a sheet held in the hand surround Tessin with the materials of cultivated public life. His turned face prevents the composition from reading simply as an inventory of possessions. The objects establish a role; the relaxed interruption of his attention makes that role appear inhabited.

works.title: The Holy Face
works.credit: Francisco de Zurbarán. The Holy Face. WikiArt source label: Public domain. Proportional resize and JPEG compression; no crop. Source: https://www.wikiart.org/en/francisco-de-zurbaran/the-holy-face
works.description: The face is faint, but the cloth that bears it has sharply described folds and shadows. That difference reverses the normal expectation that a sacred likeness should be the most solid part of an image. Zurbarán asks attention to pass through a convincingly material object before arriving at the less tangible face upon it.

works.title: The Inn of Mother Anthony
works.credit: The Inn of Mother Anthony. WikiArt; Pierre-Auguste Renoir. Proportional resizing and JPEG compression; source frame preserved.
works.description: The white cloth gives the gathered figures a common centre, while their differing positions keep the meal from becoming a formal line-up. A dog occupies the near space below them. The arrangement leaves room for ordinary bodily adjustments around a table, making companionship visible through shared occupation rather than an announced emotion.

works.title: Friends
works.credit: Hanna Hirsch-Pauli. Friends. Image credit: Hanna Pauli (1864 - 1940)  (Swedish) Details on Google Art Project; Source credit: wgGTWIkYzTLaDQ at Google Cultural Institute maximum zoom level. Wikimedia Commons. Public domain (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/mark/1.0/). Resized and JPEG-compressed; selected source frame preserved.
works.description: The lamp distributes attention unevenly. Some members of the group are close to its light; others belong to the room’s shadows. This does not prevent the painting from functioning as a group portrait. The gathering is held together by a shared situation, allowing individual visibility to vary rather than requiring every face to make its claim.

works.title: Breakfast Time
works.credit: Hanna Hirsch-Pauli. Breakfast Time. Image credit: Hanna Hirsch-Pauli. Wikimedia Commons. Public domain (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/mark/1.0/). Resized and JPEG-compressed; selected source frame preserved.
works.description: The breakfast table is prepared before it is fully occupied. On the white cloth, glass, silver and crockery break the daylight into smaller incidents. The woman beyond the table has company in the objects themselves: a domestic occasion is established through what has been arranged and made ready, not simply through the number of people present.

works.title: Marie Suzanne Roslin, née Giroust
works.catalogueTitle: Portrait of the Artist's Wife Marie Suzanne, née Giroust
works.credit: Alexander Roslin. Portrait of the Artist's Wife Marie Suzanne, née Giroust. Alexander Roslin; Nationalmuseum, Sweden (museum-contributed reproduction); Åsa Lundén / Nationalmuseum. https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Portrait_of_the_Artist%27s_Wife_Marie_Suzanne,_n%C3%A9e_Giroust_(Alexander_Roslin)_-_Nationalmuseum_-_18014.tif. Public Domain Mark (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/mark/1.0/). Full-frame proportional resize and JPEG compression.
works.description: Flowers near the shoulder and hair accompany the sitter’s turning pose. Gathered fabric carries that movement away from the face, making the portrait less rigid without making the likeness disappear into decoration. The effect depends on restraint: the accessories support the turn rather than demanding an independent reading of every flower.

works.title: Carl Linnaeus
works.credit: Alexander Roslin. Carl Linnaeus (1707–1778), Professor and Botanist, 1775. Alexander Roslin; Nationalmuseum, Sweden (museum-contributed reproduction). https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Carl_von_Linn%C3%A9,_1707-1778,_botanist,_professor_(Alexander_Roslin)_-_Nationalmuseum_-_15723.tif. Public Domain Mark (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/mark/1.0/). Full-frame proportional resize and JPEG compression.
works.description: The plant near Linnaeus’s chest is a small detail beside the dark coat, bright buttons and powdered wig. Its scale makes the professional reference unobtrusive, yet specific. Roslin keeps the conventions of a formal likeness while allowing a botanical subject to enter the sitter’s immediate space.

works.title: Our Daily Bread
works.credit: Anders Zorn. Our Daily Bread. Anders Zorn; Nationalmuseum, Sweden (museum-contributed reproduction); Erik Cornelius / Nationalmuseum. https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Our_Daily_Bread_(Anders_Zorn)_-_Nationalmuseum_-_24125.tif. Public Domain Mark (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/mark/1.0/). Full-frame proportional resize and JPEG compression.
works.description: The seated woman and steaming pot occupy the near ground; work continues in the field beyond. The meal is consequently neither an isolated still life nor a separate domestic occasion. It belongs to the same day of labour. The distance between resting and working bodies gives that relationship a visible form.

works.title: Sea Eagles
works.credit: Bruno Liljefors. Sea Eagles. Bruno Liljefors; Nationalmuseum, Sweden (museum-contributed reproduction); Erik Cornelius / Nationalmuseum. https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Sea_Eagles_(Bruno_Liljefors)_-_Nationalmuseum_-_18508.tif. Public Domain Mark (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/mark/1.0/). Full-frame proportional resize and JPEG compression.
works.description: The birds’ extended wings create competing angles over the rough shore. Their bodies have to be understood in motion, not merely recognised by their plumage. Pale sea behind them helps make the wings’ reach legible. Liljefors leaves the animals within an environment while giving their actions enough weight to organise it.

works.title: Fox in a Winter Landscape
works.credit: Bruno Liljefors. Fox in Winter Landscape. Bruno Liljefors; Nationalmuseum, Sweden (museum-contributed reproduction); Per-Åke Persson / Nationalmuseum. https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Fox_in_Winter_Landscape_(Bruno_Liljefors)_-_Nationalmuseum_-_23703.tif. Public Domain Mark (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/mark/1.0/). Full-frame proportional resize and JPEG compression.
works.description: The fox’s warm coat distinguishes it from the snow, yet the surrounding branches keep interrupting an easy view. Its visibility depends on the landscape rather than on a neutral background. The picture therefore rewards attention to both animal and cover: the setting is part of the encounter, not decorative space around a specimen.

works.title: Portrait of the Artist’s Wife
works.credit: Paul Cézanne. Portrait of the Artist's Wife. Paul Cézanne; Nationalmuseum, Sweden (museum-contributed reproduction); Erik Cornelius / Nationalmuseum. https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Portrait_of_the_Artist%27s_Wife_(Paul_C%C3%A9zanne)_-_Nationalmuseum_-_23397.tif. Public Domain Mark (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/mark/1.0/). Full-frame proportional resize and JPEG compression.
works.description: The red armchair gives the seated figure a firm enclosure. Her head inclines toward her hands, directing attention away from an exchange of looks with the spectator. Broad areas of colour preserve the weight of the body and furniture; the private occupation remains legible without disclosing a thought behind it.

works.title: Open-Air Painter: Winter Motif from Åsögatan
works.catalogueTitle: Open-Air Painter. Winter-Motif from Åsögatan 145, Stockholm
works.credit: Carl Larsson. Open-Air Painter. Winter-Motif from Åsögatan 145, Stockholm. Carl Larsson; Nationalmuseum, Sweden (museum-contributed reproduction). https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Open-Air_Painter._Winter-Motif_from_%C3%85s%C3%B6gatan_145,_Stockholm_(Carl_Larsson)_-_Nationalmuseum_-_19607.tif. Public Domain Mark (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/mark/1.0/). Full-frame proportional resize and JPEG compression.
works.description: Equipment in the foreground gives outdoor painting practical dimensions. The snow-covered yard is both the subject of the picture and the place where a painter must stand to observe it. Larsson includes that second condition. The result makes a useful comparison with landscapes that conceal every trace of the work required to produce them.

works.title: A Day of Celebration
works.catalogueTitle: A Day of Celebration. From A Home (26 watercolours)
works.credit: Carl Larsson. A Day of Celebration. From A Home (26 watercolours). Carl Larsson; Nationalmuseum, Sweden (museum-contributed reproduction); Erik Cornelius / Nationalmuseum. https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:A_Day_of_Celebration._From_A_Home_(26_watercolours)_(Carl_Larsson)_-_Nationalmuseum_-_24221.tif. Public Domain Mark (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/mark/1.0/). Full-frame proportional resize and JPEG compression.
works.description: Decorated beams, doors, rails and furniture divide the celebration into smaller episodes. The figures do not have to gather at one central point for the room to hold them together. Repeated colours and architectural boundaries carry attention between them, showing how a designed interior can participate in an occasion.

works.title: Letter-Writing
works.credit: Carl Larsson. Letter-Writing. Carl Larsson; Nationalmuseum, Sweden (museum-contributed reproduction); Erik Cornelius / Nationalmuseum. https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Letter-Writing_(Carl_Larsson)_-_Nationalmuseum_-_25407.tif. Public Domain Mark (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/mark/1.0/). Full-frame proportional resize and JPEG compression.
works.description: The letter’s contents remain private. What the picture offers instead is the writer’s bent posture and the setting that makes the task possible: desk, window, plants and surrounding woodwork. A modest action gains specificity from its place. There is no need to invent the message in order to understand the concentration.

works.title: Murre: Portrait of Casimir Laurin
works.credit: Carl Larsson. "Murre". Portrait of Casimir Laurin. Carl Larsson; Nationalmuseum, Sweden (museum-contributed reproduction). https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Murre_._Portrait_of_Casimir_Laurin_(Carl_Larsson)_-_Nationalmuseum_-_90181.tif. Public Domain Mark (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/mark/1.0/). Full-frame proportional resize and JPEG compression.
works.description: The rocking horse places the child’s seated pose on a different footing from an adult portrait. Its curved runners and the red coat give the small figure a clear setting within the heavier furniture. The toy remains recognisable as an object for movement, even while its rider holds still for a likeness.

closingSections.title: Compare a pause with a gathering
paragraphs: Put *The Kitchen Maid* beside *Friends*, or *Letter-Writing* beside *Breakfast Time*. Each pair distinguishes private attention from a shared occasion without reducing either to a fixed mood. Holdings and display are different questions; check the museum’s current listings before planning around a particular work.
